usage: agentware init [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                      --knowledge-dir KNOWLEDGE_DIR [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --knowledge-dir KNOWLEDGE_DIR
                        absolute or ~ path to store this operator's knowledge
  --force               repoint the config even if a different, already-
                        initialized knowledge base is currently configured
